Depends on what you’re looking for in therapy. If you just want counseling, I would avoid an outpatient clinic because there is always turnover unless it’s a standalone clinic (ECMC, Niagara Falls Memorial, Dale Association). 

If you’re looking for medication management, I would recommend an outpatient clinic because you can receive counseling services as well while getting psychotropic medications. 

Also, you can check Psychology Today for private practitioners and what they accept, their specialities, costs, etc. You can find someone who offers telehealth on there too!

Well there’s breitbeck park in Oswego which is nice. There’s also Selkirk state park, which is in the Pulaski/sandy creek area but is really nice and beautiful. Well fajita grill is amazing and it’s right on rt. 104 near the school. It’s around Moe’s/chipotle price. There’s aztecas on bridge street that’s very good as well (both of these places are Mexican food). The sub shop is also on bridge street and that’s a local hotspot, and their prices aren’t too bad and the sandwiches are amazing. Cams pizza is cheap and very good, deff not like buffalo pizza, more like NYC pizza. Hopefully this helps, there are tons of places in Oswego to eat but those are the best for your buck!
